svg.title: IndexCache: shared index computation across transformer layers
svg.desc: A stack of 8 transformer layers. Full layers (purple) run the indexer and compute fresh top-k indices. Shared layers (gray) skip the indexer entirely and reuse the cached indices from the nearest full layer above, shown by dashed arrows flowing downward.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does a full layer do in IndexCache?')
sendPrompt('What does a shared layer do in IndexCache?')
sendPrompt('Why do some layers recompute indices in IndexCache?')
sendPrompt('How expensive is running the indexer at every layer?')
sendPrompt('How much compute does index sharing save?')
sendPrompt('What is the compute saving from IndexCache?')
g.text: indexer runs only on full layers,

svg.text: Full layer — indexer runs, indices cached
